review_scope: Independent selected sufficient-rule, quantifier, same-object, classification, residual-contract, historical coverage and narrative review. The underlying formal proof is assumed fully checked and correct; D concerns human reconstruction only.

findings.detail: Both roots retain the exact ten topDesWin contracts: DesignExists and nine Closed predicates, their class inclusions and HypV side condition. The epsilon cutoff and transport tuple precede selection of one family and CH; later x thresholds precede every member, word and place. Constants Cabs=2,C0=3,eD=2,eL=0 and the actual C5=4 are unchanged. The graph is an explicit sufficient-interface audit, not a proof of mathematical minimality or an exhaustive Lean declaration graph.

RH is instantiated only at the principal target. Both roots reach the I/II/V suppliers; RH reaches no CaseIII, SeedIV or Ctx3 producer, while unrestricted Dirichlet GRH retains them. KA5-KA6 are used only for two-primary targets. CorGK at the fixed Kchi is the consumed I interface, with PropGK a stronger sufficient supplier. CountI's field and CountV's Gaussian/quartic field are not identified, and the selected universal CountV producer is explicitly stronger than the principal target restriction.

GVC1-GVC18 close the literal same-object CountF, full NumsL/WtsL, universal ConclusionF5/F6 and SlopesMF implications. The derivative size is a projection of the same supplied FamP.sizes, not an independent analytic supplier. The contract does not silently close stronger FamilyVandermondeCountExplicit, PartFiveFamilyBounds or arbitrary-space PropZ statements. These global degree counts are not the cohomological CountI/II/III/V producers.

GFA1-GFA12 now supply the exact type-prime constant36, original coarse Ta<=b^2, PlacesF/SlopesNF, actual positive RR rank and LatF, full all-H FrameF, NodesF, all seventeen Win_at clauses and all four Char_at clauses. The same ideal shifts, local quotient lengths, metrics, primitive characters and pre-member thresholds are preserved. The frame consumer does not acquire an upper bound on H and covers uFrame=0.

TASK_GL_FINAL_ASSEMBLY remains open B, narrowed to the original LossFS(Fm,0), same-family linkCore/ChainTied installation and final Closed wrapper. The exact original top/bottom values, ledger fields, epsilon cutoff and transport tuple remain required. Existing GVC/GFA consumers do not produce the common family/selector, LinkG, LinkS, LinkIRR or LinkDIV. The completed FamGLmin packet is conditional on the original compatible second layer.

GLOBAL_FULL_RANK still has the smaller RSL route: actual second layer, original ramified inclusion and the completed fullness/rank arguments. Its dependency closure excludes GL4 and final slope assembly. D3 membership supplies TuSize, while the selected stronger local-operator supplier retains its explicit size-to-HidaSetting gate and the same original forms. The construction-class TuSize/RankM certificates retain cT=cTmin and do not imply compatible-family existence.

The TAE packet is added only inside the same-Bundle base theta extension leaf. Its actual-action smoothness, uniform derivative-growth exponent, dominated differentiation, vacuum transfer and lowering are conditional in their recorded scope. The leaf still requires one io_i valid for every parameter, LowSm/LowIrr for the full lowKSub including multiplicity one, boundedness and finite target volume, and the extremal coefficient/Sobolev-continuous Hilbert multiplicity realization. IsHolCuspKMap is not mistaken for MMap. Geometric readings, rational tests and actual base rows remain distinct coupled producers.

COUNT_II_SUPPORT remains an opaque coupled C producer for both original rank-four Links at fixed iota, with one threshold before every later coefficient DVR and universal B/Lambda. One ideal must satisfy all six Hida fields and P1core. CIP closes the nested exact every-map split-CM reciprocity matching and the full universal NiceI instance of Norm with original D0, flags, determinant law and characteristic3; generic NiceE Norm is not inferred. Ordinary/control/arithmetic fibers, remaining Hida fields, same-J all-level HasAut and the remaining single-point arithmetic/patching inputs are still explicit.

All 13 work-refinement nodes and their links remain nonlogical; eight optional stronger/reuse routes remain outside selected reachability. In particular RigII is kept as a whole open contract, not supplied by its KatoTwo refinement alone. The generic direct-gap/AQ route remains an optional conditional interface and does not replace the selected arithmetic producers.

The complete selected register has exactly 35 open leaves: 23 C, 10 B and 2 D. The nested reciprocity D reduction was inside a C leaf and therefore does not reduce the top-level D count. Completed category-A applications remain recorded separately. The unchanged total is correctly described as work inside coupled contracts, not a percentage or an absence of progress.

All 245 historical records and their original IDs/index order/full-record hashes are retained in 107 scope groups. The ten originally unnamed records remain explicitly tracked. Every record has A/B/C/D and applicability; additive v0.34 updates preserve compound scopes rather than retiring entire records when only one subargument closes. Historical navigation categories are not conflated with current selected leaf counts.

The new A registry records three precise Milne local/global class-field-theory and norm applications with checked number-field/completion/Weil hypotheses and references. Every-map matching, split-CM unit injectivity and the cyclotomic sign remain independently proved CIP arguments. Earlier A registries are retained by hash. The four component reviews cover all 55 new claims and bind the released proof, provenance and closure files. This graph review uses those component reviews for their internal mathematics; it is not a fresh reconstruction of every inherited producer.

The TeX narrative and standalone audit were read against the current graph and four component closure files. The standalone file reproduces every remaining selected contract verbatim modulo whitespace. It retains the 401-to-400 host window, final exponent 1/2+9epsilon, one-family bindings and all new residuals. The audit text and root standalone digest are byte-identical.

Independent traversal finds no missing reference or cycle, all 121 selected nodes are root-reachable, and the two roots reach 101 and 110 nodes. Logical edges/categories/statuses are unchanged from the reviewed v0.33 graph; only explicitly scoped contracts/evidence are refined. All current source-input hashes, proof/ledger links and source-evidence ranges match their released or pinned files. All 245 backlog source ranges also match the pin.
